runs.text: The review reports the ATCC holdings of this species in its biosafety discussion:

runs.quote: Among the 235 S. marcescens strains available from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC), 208 strains (88.5%) are designated as Biosafety Level 1 (BSL-1) according to Biosafety in Micro-biological and Biomedical Laboratories

runs.text: This containment level is described as appropriate for well-characterized agents not known to consistently cause disease in immunocompetent adults, where standard microbiological practices suffice.

runs.text: A much smaller group sits at the higher level:

runs.quote: Only 10 strains are designated as BSL-2, which is suitable for biological agents associ-ated with human disease and posing moderate potential hazards to personnel and the environment

runs.text: The named categories therefore leave a residue of strains whose designation is not given in the text:

runs.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN id='p12.L11' THEN CAST(regexp_extract(text,'([0-9]+) S\. marcescens',1) AS INTEGER) WHEN id='p12.L12' THEN -CAST(regexp_extract(text,'([0-9]+) strains',1) AS INTEGER) WHEN id='p12.L17' THEN -CAST(regexp_extract(text,'Only ([0-9]+) strains',1) AS INTEGER) END) AS remainder FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p12.L11','p12.L12','p12.L17')
